settings.text: A felt insert that turns any open-top tote into a structured commute bag. Drop in, pull out, move between bags.

settings.title: Details
settings.content: Bring order to your favorite tote. The Velantra Bag Organizer drops straight into Speedy, Neverfull, Bogg and more — removable dividers and multiple pockets keep everything findable, then lift out in one piece when you switch bags.

settings.title: Materials & Care
settings.content:
Material
Premium structured felt with removable dividers.

Care
Spot clean with a damp cloth and air dry. Remove the dividers to reshape or store flat.

settings.title: Dimensions
settings.content:
Size
11.4" L × 5.5" W × 7.1" H (29 × 14 × 18 cm). Also available in multiple sizes — see the size selector.

Removable dividers · multiple interior pockets · lightweight, portable design.

settings.title: Shipping & Returns
settings.content:
Free shipping on all orders over $75. Once your order is placed, it ships and arrives within 7 to 10 business days.

We accept returns within 30 days of delivery for items in original, unused condition with all tags attached. Exchanges are always free. If something isn’t right, reach out — we’ll make it right.

settings.title: Two Year Warranty
settings.content:
Every Velantra piece is covered for two years against defects in materials and construction. If anything goes wrong in normal use, we’ll repair or replace it.

After two years, we continue to offer repair service for the cost of materials. Designed to last decades, not seasons.

settings.heading: Two-Year Warranty
settings.body: Every Velantra bag is built to last. If anything fails in normal use, we’ll repair or replace it.

settings.headline: Six Pockets, Free-Standing
settings.body: A felt insert that holds a laptop, a water bottle, a phone, keys, and the small things that get lost.

settings.headline: Pressed Wool Felt
settings.body: Holds its shape inside any bag. Moves between bags without sagging.

settings.headline: 70% Recycled Wool
settings.body: Compostable at the end of its life. Built to last long enough that it won’t be.
